step.label: Qualify sales opportunities for targeted engagement
step.description: Sales team needs to identify high-potential customer accounts and opportunities before initiating outreach campaigns.
step.useCase: CRM advisor scores sales opportunities against customer account fit and readiness criteria

step.label: Segment customers for personalized marketing campaigns
step.description: Marketing department requires precise customer targeting to launch tailored engagement campaigns based on account profiles and historical engagement.
step.useCase: Campaign API enables marketing to activate targeted contact lists tied to specific customer account segments and campaign objectives

step.label: Verify supply chain readiness for product launches
step.description: Product management and procurement need confidence that materials, vendors, and supply chain processes support planned product changes and engineering modifications.
step.useCase: Supply Chain Intelligence provides real-time material and engineering change impact analysis across the vendor network

step.label: Automate safety compliance reviews for engineering changes
step.description: Operations and EHS teams must ensure all product and material modifications meet safety and regulatory standards before production deployment.
step.useCase: Safety Compliance Coordinator agent validates engineering changes, materials, and product items against enterprise safety and compliance rules

step.label: Inspect and validate manufacturing quality metrics
step.description: Quality assurance and manufacturing operations require real-time visibility into production order quality and inspection results to prevent defects and ensure consistency.
step.useCase: Quality Metrics Hub aggregates production order and inspection data to track conformance and identify process improvement opportunities

step.label: Evaluate procurement compliance and vendor performance
step.description: Procurement leadership needs assurance that purchase orders, contracts, and vendor relationships comply with policy and deliver expected performance.
step.useCase: Procurement Compliance Analytics evaluates contracts, purchase orders, and vendor performance against organizational compliance standards

step.label: Reconcile workforce compensation structures across entities
step.description: Finance and compensation teams require consolidated visibility into employee compensation data across multiple business entities to ensure equity, governance, and budget accuracy.
step.useCase: Compensation Structure API surfaces employee and workforce person compensation hierarchies for finance governance and audit purposes

step.label: Process payroll and validate employee payment data
step.description: HR and Finance must execute timely, accurate payroll processing with full control over employee and workforce person payment records to meet regulatory and organizational requirements.
step.useCase: Payroll Processing system manages employee compensation execution, validation, and payment distribution with audit controls
